intro: Many of my clients come through the accountant or lawyer who already knows them best. When the lending touches a company, a trust and personal borrowing, hand it to me. I'll work alongside the advice you've already given and keep you updated, so you're glad you made the introduction.

steps.title: You introduce
steps.text: A client whose lending needs more than a standard loan. A quick note or call is enough.

steps.title: I get the picture
steps.text: I work with you and your client to understand the structures you've already set up.

steps.title: You stay in the loop
steps.text: I keep you across the plan, so the lending supports the advice you've given.
